mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.order_id, r.reviewer_id, u1.username AS reviewer_username, r.reviewee_id, u2.username AS reviewee_username, r.reviewer_role, r.rating, r.content, r.is_anonymous, r.reply_content, r.reply_time, r.created_at FROM order_review r LEFT JOIN user u1 ON r.reviewer_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON r.reviewee_id = u2.id WHERE r.id = #{reviewId} AND r.status = 1
